steps: Detach A axis from LM1 in PPP1.
Verify PPP1 has detached A axis before PPP2 attaches it to LM2.
Check that PPP2 does not attempt to attach A axis before PPP1 completes detachment.
Verify both PPP1 and PPP2 are using consistent logical machine assignments.
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Verify the axis is no longer attached to logical machine 2
Check that the program in mdi1.pp attempts to attach the x' axis to logical machine 1
Ensure PPP1 detaches the axis before PPP2 attaches it to a different logical machine
Activate the part program named m101.pp
Verify the part program exists in the search hierarchy
Check that the M-code M101 is configured for mode 4
Add three control points between splineon and splineoff.
Verify points are specified after G60 and before G61.
Check that no fm or st is programmed after splineon.
Validate spline type is uniform, chord, or bspline.
Remove duplicate class 1 preparatory words from the block.
Check the program for multiple G-code commands in the same block.
Verify that only one dimension or interpolation word is used per block.
Set the Joint logical device for joint 5 to the correct logical address.
Verify the logical address matches the device setup.
Check the device mapping configuration for duplicates.
Disable sets opcua.enable to false
Verify opcua.enable is false in configuration
Check OPC UA server status after restart
Reset the EtherCAT bus
Verify the device station address is 0x03
Check the current state matches expected OP
Acknowledge the emergency message
Verify error code is 0x2350
Check error register is 0x04
Reinitialise the EtherCAT bus
Verify the cyclic task ID is 1
Check the error type for CRC in frame response
Upgrade device Drive_3 firmware to 1.4.0
Verify firmware version in DBA matches expected 1.4.0
Check fieldbus state is INIT or PREOP
Verify device Drive_3 has dsd_firmware_version set to 1.4.0
